hadith:
Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh)) - Narrated Ibn Masud:

During the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) the moon was split into two parts; one part remained over the mountain, and the other part went beyond the mountain. On that, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Witness this miracle."
message: Allah's power is boundless—He split the moon as a miracle for those who witnessed it, yet some still denied His signs. On the Day of Judgment, those who rejected His messages will face tremendous suffering, so reflect on the wonders around you and turn to Allah with sincere belief. Remember that Allah's mercy (Ar-Raheem) extends to all who seek His forgiveness and guidance, so never lose hope in His compassion.
name:
Ar Raheem - الرَّحِيمُ - The Merciful

The name Ar-Raheem originates from the Arabic root 'R-H-M', which denotes mercy and compassion. It signifies Allah's attribute of bestowing kindness and forgiveness to His creatures, highlighting the importance of mercy in the Islamic faith. Ar-Raheem often appears alongside Ar-Rahman, which also denotes mercy but encompasses a broader, universal aspect, while Ar-Raheem focuses more on a specific, heartfelt mercy towards the believers.
